posts.title: Park roads right now
posts.caption:
Park road update for your guests:

• Heintooga Ridge Road, Parson Branch Road, and Rich Mountain Road are closed for the season.
• Park Headquarters Road is closed due to rehabilitation work on the Sugarlands water and wastewater systems.
• Kuwohi Road, Roaring Fork Motor Nature Trail and Little Greenbrier Road close for the season on Nov 29.

Parking in the park over 15 minutes needs a tag ($5 a day, $15 a week).

Live updates: thesmokiesbrief.com
